content.text:
A PreToolUse hook blocked the Write call, so the file was not written. Here is the exact tool result:

```
PreToolUse:Write hook error: ["<HOME>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\PythonSoftwareFoundation.Python.3.12_qbz5n2kfra8p0\python.exe" "<MNEME_SRC>\docs\validation\artifacts\adr033-c3-claude-code-enforcement-live\harness\missing_hookwrap.py"]: <HOME>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\PythonSoftwareFoundation.Python.3.12_qbz5n2kfra8p0\python.exe: can't open file '<MNEME_SRC>\\docs\\validation\\artifacts\\adr033-c3-claude-code-enforcement-live\\harness\\missing_hookwrap.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
```

The hook script `missing_hookwrap.py` doesn't exist, so Python couldn't run it. Python exits with code 2 when it can't open a script, and Claude Code treats exit code 2 from a PreToolUse hook as a block, so the hook failed closed. As you asked, I didn't retry, work around it, or check afterwards whether `service.py` exists.
